card.name: Scholar names in old citations
card.fires_on: The end of an author's surname, or the 's, apostrophe or comma right after it, in old scholarly texts citing a named authority. Seen in 19th-century works on classics, geology and physiology.

modes.label: Possessive or comma after surname
modes.description: The 's, apostrophe or comma that follows a cited scholar's name in a reference.

modes.label: Inside a surname
modes.description: A late piece of a foreign surname, such as a French or German scientist's name.
